title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
title_zh: 运动员作为单一样本的科学家：面向消费级可穿戴设备个体化生理学的智能体贝叶斯实验设计

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents for personal health read wearable data and recommend, but do not learn about the individual in a way that can be audited or falsified. We present EpiCoach , an agentic system that treats one athlete, a cross-country mountain biker, as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science. Claims about the athlete live in an evidence-gated hypothesis registry : each must issue a probabilistic prediction about a future session before it occurs, and its belief moves only through computed evidence from a logged statistical fit. Predictions come from a mechanistic digital twin inferred from heart rate, GPS and barometric altitude: a lagged heart-rate response model, a fitness–fatigue model with learned time constants, and a latent technical-descending skill state, measured on discovered trail segments. The agent prescribes the next training week as a constrained experiment maximizing information gain subject to load and safety constraints, around two instrument rides. We evaluate the system two ways over eighteen months of data. A rolling-origin replay benchmark shows the twin beats standard forecasters on heart rate but not segment time, and the agentic loop matches a static model. A live prospective phase runs the weekly cycle: in its first three weeks the ledger sealed 20 predictions, scored 14, the descent forecast calibrated after one correction, the climb forecast pessimistic as the athlete improved, and the safety officer vetoed the agent twice. Every correction is preserved in the registry, a template for auditable, falsifiable personalization in digital health. We release the registry, benchmark and protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 用于个人健康的大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以读取可穿戴设备数据并给出建议，但它们无法以可审计或可证伪的方式了解个体情况。 我们提出 EpiCoach，一个智能体系统，它将一名运动员——一位山地越野自行车手——作为可问责的单受试者（N-of-1）科学的研究对象。 关于运动员的论断保存在一个由证据把关的假设登记簿中：每条论断必须在未来的训练课发生之前给出概率性预测，且其信念只能通过基于已记录的统计拟合计算出的证据来更新。 预测来自由心率、GPS 和气压海拔推断出的机制化数字孪生模型：一个带滞后项的心率响应模型、一个具有学习到的时间常数的体能—疲劳模型，以及在发现的赛道段上测量的潜在下坡技术状态。 该智能体将下一周的训练计划作为一个受约束的实验来开处方，在负荷和安全约束下围绕两次安装了传感器的骑行最大化信息增益。 我们以两种方式在十八个月的数据上评估该系统。 滚动起点的回放基准显示，该数字孪生模型在心率上优于标准预测器，但在赛道段时间上并非如此，且智能体循环与静态模型表现相当。 一个前瞻性实时阶段运行每周循环：在最初三周内，登记簿封存了 20 条预测，其中 14 条已评分；下坡预测在一次修正后达到校准，爬坡预测在运动员水平提升后显得悲观，安全官两次否决了智能体的方案。 每一次修正都保留在登记簿中，为数字健康中可审计、可证伪的个性化提供了一种模板。 我们公开登记簿、基准和协议。

paragraphs.en: A coach who has worked with the same athlete for years knows things about that athlete that no textbook contains: that her heart rate climbs by six beats per hour once the temperature passes 28 ∘ 28^{\circ} C, that two short nights cost her more on technical descents than on climbs, that she holds fitness longer than the forty-two-day constant assumed by every training platform. This knowledge is individual, it was acquired by watching many sessions, and, crucially, it was tested : the coach predicted, observed, and revised. Consumer wearables now record the raw material for this kind of knowledge continuously, and LLM agents can reason over it. Yet the systems built so far do something quite different from what the experienced coach does.
paragraphs.zh: 一位与同一名运动员共事多年的教练，掌握着任何教科书都没有的知识：一旦气温超过 28^{\circ} C，她的心率每小时会上升六次；两个短暂的睡眠不足之夜，在技术性下坡路段对她的影响比在上坡时更大；她保持体能的时间比所有训练平台假定的四十二天常数要长。 这些知识是个体化的，是通过观察大量训练获得的，而且关键在于，它经过了检验：教练做出预测、进行观察、然后修正。 消费级可穿戴设备如今能够持续记录这类知识的原始素材，而 LLM 智能体可以对这些素材进行推理。 然而迄今为止构建的系统，所做的却与经验丰富的教练的工作大不相同。

paragraphs.en: Recent personal-health agents are impressive readers of wearable data. PH-LLM fine-tunes Gemini to produce expert-rated coaching from thirty-day summaries [ 1 ] ; PHIA answers open-ended numerical questions over wearable time series by generating and running code [ 2 ] ; the Personal Health Agent orchestrates data-scientist, domain-expert and coach sub-agents [ 3 ] ; SePA grounds advice in personalized risk models and trusted retrieval [ 4 ] ; LLM-SPTRec generates training plans from a sports-science knowledge graph [ 5 ] . All of them share a direction of information flow: data in, recommendation out, population knowledge applied to an individual. None maintains a body of claims about this particular person that is explicit, probabilistic, revised by evidence, and exposed to falsification. If such a system tells the athlete that her heart rate drifts in the heat, nothing records whether that claim was ever tested, what it would take to overturn it, or whether it was quietly abandoned.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的个人健康智能体在解读可穿戴设备数据方面表现出色。 PH-LLM 对 Gemini 进行微调，以根据三十天摘要生成由专家评分的指导建议 [ 1 ]；PHIA 通过生成并运行代码来回答关于可穿戴设备时间序列的开放式数值问题 [ 2]；Personal Health Agent 编排数据科学家、领域专家和教练等子智能体 [ 3 ]；SePA 将建议建立在个性化风险模型和可信检索的基础上 [ 4 ]；LLM-SPTRec 从体育科学知识图谱中生成训练计划 [ 5 ]。 它们全都共享同一个信息流方向：数据输入，推荐输出，把群体知识应用于个人。 没有一个系统维护着一组关于这个特定个体的论断——这些论断是显式的、概率性的、会随证据修订的，并且暴露于可被证伪的检验之下。 如果这样的系统告诉运动员她的心率在炎热环境中会出现漂移，却没有任何记录说明这一论断是否曾被检验过、推翻它需要什么条件，或者它是否已被悄然放弃。

paragraphs.en: We argue that the missing object is not a better recommender but an epistemic loop , and that building one for a single human raises problems that automated-science systems in chemistry or biology [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] do not face. The subject cannot be reset; every observation costs a training session that also changes the system being studied; the measurements are noisy wrist sensors rather than assays; and the designer has a second objective, making the athlete better, that competes with learning about her. paragraphs.en: A prediction ledger, not a chat log. Every hypothesis in the registry must emit a probabilistic prediction about a specific future ride, timestamped before the ride. Beliefs move only through a tool that requires a logged statistical fit. This is what makes N = 1 N{=}1 science defensible: it closes the garden of forking paths [ 9 , 10 ] that would otherwise let a fluent language model explain any outcome after the fact.
paragraphs.zh: 一个预测账本，而非聊天记录。 注册表中的每个假设都必须针对某次具体的未来行程发出概率性预测，并在行程发生之前加上时间戳。 信念只能通过一个要求记录统计拟合的工具来更新。 这正是使 N = 1 N{=}1 科学站得住脚的关键：它关闭了分叉路径的花园 [ 9 , 10 ]，否则流畅的语言模型就能在事后解释任何结果。

paragraphs.en: Workouts as experiments, with safety as a hard constraint. The next ride is chosen from a menu by a utility that trades expected information gain against expected performance improvement, subject to acute:chronic workload bounds, heart-rate caps and readiness gates enforced in code rather than by the language model. Repeated trail segments, discovered automatically, serve as the measurement instrument.

paragraphs.en: (i) A formalization of coaching as sequential, safety-constrained Bayesian experimental design over an evidence-gated hypothesis registry with a pre-registered prediction ledger (Section III ). (ii) A wrist-only digital twin for mountain biking with explicit identifiability analysis of its fitness–fatigue component (Section IV ). (iii) An agent architecture, implemented in Google ADK, whose protocol, not its prompts, guarantees that LLMs propose, select and explain while deterministic tools fit, score and gate (Section V ). (iv) A public rolling-origin replay benchmark for individualized physiological forecasting with retrospective results on eighteen months of data, and the first three weeks of a live, pre-registered prospective N = 1 N{=}1 phase with its complete audit trail (Section VI ).

paragraphs.en: PH-LLM [ 1 ] fine-tunes a frontier model on expert case studies built from thirty-day aggregates and reasons in-model. PHIA [ 2 ] is a ReAct agent [ 13 ] with a Python runtime and web search, evaluated on thousands of insight questions. The Personal Health Agent [ 3 ] adds orchestration across specialist sub-agents; PhysioLLM [ 14 ] adds a statistical-correlation layer; SePA [ 4 ] adds personalized predictive models and whitelisted retrieval. These systems answer questions and give advice. None keeps a persistent, probabilistic, falsifiable model of the user, none chooses what data to collect next, and none writes an intervention back to the device. We use PHIA-style agents as a baseline and PHA-style orchestration as a point of contrast.
paragraphs.zh: PH-LLM [ 1 ] 基于由三十天聚合数据构建的专家案例研究对前沿模型进行微调，并在模型内部进行推理。 PHIA [ 2 ] 是一个配备 Python 运行时和网络搜索的 ReAct 智能体 [ 13 ]，在数千个洞察问题上进行了评估。 Personal Health Agent [ 3 ] 增加了对专家子智能体的编排；PhysioLLM [ 14 ] 增加了统计相关性层；SePA [ 4 ] 增加了个性化预测模型和白名单检索。 这些系统回答问题并提供建议。 它们都不维护关于用户的持久、概率性、可证伪的模型，都不选择下一步该收集什么数据，也都不将干预措施写回设备。 我们以 PHIA 风格的智能体作为基线，并以 PHA 风格的编排作为对比参照。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end automated research systems [ 6 , 7 ] close a hypothesize–experiment–analyze loop in silico or in the wet lab, where replicates are cheap and the system under study is stationary. The Hypothesis Evolution Protocol [ 8 ] externalizes hypotheses as registry objects with evidence-gated beliefs, lineage and lifecycle; we adopt this discipline and add the ledger requirement that every hypothesis issues a dated prediction about an unobserved outcome. Box’s loop with language models [ 15 , 16 ] and the Automatic Statistician [ 17 ] use LLMs to propose and criticize probabilistic programs on fixed data; BoxingGym [ 18 ] benchmarks LLM agents on information-gain-driven design in simulated environments and finds them weak at it. Our setting is BoxingGym’s real-world counterpart with a living subject, irreversible state and a dual objective.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端自动化研究系统 [ 6 , 7 ] 在计算机模拟或湿实验环境中闭合「假设—实验—分析」循环，其中重复实验成本低廉，且所研究的系统是稳定的。 假设演化协议 [ 8 ] 将假设外部化为注册表对象，使其具备基于证据门控的信念、谱系与生命周期；我们采用这一规范，并增加账本要求，即每个假设都必须针对一个尚未观测的结果作出带日期的预测。 结合语言模型的 Box 循环 [ 15 , 16 ] 与自动统计学家 [ 17 ] 利用大语言模型在固定数据上提出并批评概率程序；BoxingGym [ 18 ] 在模拟环境中对大语言模型智能体在信息增益驱动的实验设计上的表现进行了基准测试，发现它们在此方面能力薄弱。 我们的场景是 BoxingGym 的现实世界对应版本，研究对象是活体，状态不可逆，且目标具有双重性。

paragraphs.en: The Banister impulse-response model [ 19 , 20 ] and the Busso variable-dose variant [ 21 ] relate training load to performance through fitness and fatigue filters; they are known to be ill-conditioned [ 22 , 23 ] and sensitive to the load metric [ 24 ] . Kalman-filter variants track parameters online [ 25 ] ; optimal-control and reinforcement-learning methods optimize load schedules given fitted parameters. We treat parameter uncertainty as the object to be reduced by design, and we use only wrist-derived load and segment-based performance rather than power meters or laboratory tests.
paragraphs.zh: Banister 冲激响应模型 [19, 20] 以及 Busso 变剂量变体 [21] 通过体能和疲劳滤波器将训练负荷与运动表现联系起来；已知它们是病态的 [22, 23]，并且对负荷度量敏感 [24]。 卡尔曼滤波变体可在线跟踪参数 [25]；最优控制和强化学习方法则在拟合参数给定的情况下优化负荷计划。 我们将参数不确定性视为需要通过设计来削减的对象，并且仅使用来自腕部的负荷和基于分段的运动表现，而不使用功率计或实验室测试。

paragraphs.en: Cross-country mountain biking is characterized by sustained high heart rates that remain elevated on descents despite low power output, attributed to isometric load and arousal [ 11 , 12 ] ; performance is multidimensional and course-specific [ 31 ] ; rolling resistance varies two- to three-fold with surface [ 32 ] . These facts shape the twin: heart rate is a fitness signal only on climbs, descending is a separate skill, and rolling resistance is a segment-level nuisance.
paragraphs.zh: 越野山地自行车赛的特点是心率持续处于高位，即使在低功率输出的下坡时心率依然保持升高，这归因于等长负荷与应激唤醒 [11, 12]；其表现是多维的且因赛道而异 [31]；滚动阻力随路面的不同可变化两到三倍 [32]。 这些事实塑造了这个数字孪生：心率仅在爬坡时是体能信号，下坡是一项独立的技能，而滚动阻力是路段层面的干扰因素。

paragraphs.en: A hypothesis H = ( text , ϕ H , π H ) H=(\text{text},\phi_{H},\pi_{H}) consists of a natural-language claim; a formal predicate ϕ H : Θ → { 0 , 1 } \phi_{H}:\Theta\to\{0,1\} or a sub-model M H M_{H} ; a belief π H ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \pi_{H}\in(0,1) ; together with a lifecycle state in { proposed , under_test , supported , refuted , undetermined , retired } and parent pointers recording refinement and merging.
paragraphs.zh: 假设 H = ( text , ϕ H , π H ) H=(\text{text},\phi_{H},\pi_{H}) 由以下部分组成：一个自然语言断言；一个形式化谓词 ϕ H : Θ → { 0 , 1 } \phi_{H}:\Theta\to\{0,1\} 或一个子模型 M H M_{H} ；一个信念度 π H ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \pi_{H}\in(0,1) ；以及一个取值于 { proposed , under_test , supported , refuted , undetermined , retired } 的生命周期状态，还有记录细化与合并关系的父指针。

paragraphs.en: Two rules distinguish our registry from a free-form notebook. Evidence gating (inherited from [ 8 ] ): π H \pi_{H} changes only through record_evidence ( H H , log ⁡ BF \log\mathrm{BF} , fit_id ), where log ⁡ BF \log\mathrm{BF} is a log Bayes factor or an equivalent evidence score computed by a deterministic fit whose identifier exists in the statistician’s store, and the update is logit ⁡ π H ← logit ⁡ π H + log ⁡ BF \operatorname{logit}\pi_{H}\leftarrow\operatorname{logit}\pi_{H}+\log\mathrm{BF} [ 33 ] . The language model has no tool that sets π H \pi_{H} directly. Ledger requirement (ours): a hypothesis may enter under_test only after predict ​ ( H , r ∗ , q H ) \texttt{predict}(H,\ r^{\ast},\ q_{H}) has registered a predictive distribution q H q_{H} for a specified future ride r ∗ r^{\ast} , and the registry refuses the call if its timestamp is later than the ride’s start. Ledger predictions are scored with proper scoring rules [ 34 ] when r ∗ r^{\ast} is observed, and the scores are the only admissible evidence for hypotheses about predictive claims. Identifiability gate (ours): for a directional claim about a parameter, a Savage–Dickey-style log ⁡ BF \log\mathrm{BF} is admitted only if the posterior standard deviation has shrunk by at least 10 % 10\% relative to the prior; otherwise the evidence is recorded as zero (the test still consumes budget). Without this rule a bounded prior that is merely re-shaped by weak data can masquerade as evidence; it did so for the fitness time constant in our own data (Section IV-E ). paragraphs.en: Repeated terrain converts an uncontrolled ride into a repeated-measures design. We build the athlete’s trail network from OpenStreetMap: all named ways tagged as paths, tracks or service roads within each riding area are fetched, ways sharing a name are joined end-to-end into a chain , and each chain is densified to 5 5 m points carrying an along-trail coordinate s s . Every GPS sample is snapped to the nearest chain point within 20 20 m, which gives it a trail name and a scalar position; a run is a contiguous stretch of samples on one chain with monotone s s , and its sign gives the direction (the same trail ridden up and down is two segments). Because riders enter and leave a trail at different points, timing the whole trail would inflate variance. We therefore define a segment by consensus gates : the longest stretch of s s covered by at least 60 % 60\% of the rides that touch the chain (and by at least five rides). A traversal is a pass from the entry gate to the exit gate with monotone progress and no stop longer than 90 90 s; entry and exit times are interpolated at the gate crossings. Each traversal records moving time (the primary timing outcome; wall-clock time is inflated by trail-side stops), heart-rate summary and quality, mean virtual power, ambient temperature, elapsed ride time, recent precipitation and gear. Appendix A gives thresholds and failure modes; Appendix G lists the discovered segments.

sents.en: We build the athlete’s trail network from OpenStreetMap: all named ways tagged as paths, tracks or service roads within each riding area are fetched, ways sharing a name are joined end-to-end into a chain , and each chain is densified to 5 5 m points carrying an along-trail coordinate s s .

sents.en: Every GPS sample is snapped to the nearest chain point within 20 20 m, which gives it a trail name and a scalar position; a run is a contiguous stretch of samples on one chain with monotone s s , and its sign gives the direction (the same trail ridden up and down is two segments).

sents.en: Because riders enter and leave a trail at different points, timing the whole trail would inflate variance.

sents.en: We therefore define a segment by consensus gates : the longest stretch of s s covered by at least 60 % 60\% of the rides that touch the chain (and by at least five rides).

paragraphs.en: Three consequences follow. First, the registry reports “ τ 1 < 42 \tau_{1}<42 days” as unresolved: the identifiability gate (Section III ) refused the raw log ⁡ BF \log\mathrm{BF} of + 1.45 +1.45 because the posterior had widened relative to the prior. paragraphs.en: EpiCoach is a weekly cycle implemented as a Google ADK SequentialAgent with one inner LoopAgent [ 45 ] (Figure 1 ). The architecture is not novel for being multi-agent; orchestrated specialist agents already exist for wearables [ 3 ] . What we claim is the allocation : every operation that produces a number the system will act on is performed by a deterministic tool, and the language model is confined to the operations where its strengths are real and its failure modes are survivable.
paragraphs.zh: EpiCoach 是一个以 Google ADK SequentialAgent 实现的周循环智能体，其中包含一个内层 LoopAgent [ 45 ]（图 1 ）。 该架构的新颖之处并不在于多智能体；用于可穿戴设备的编排式专用智能体已经存在 [ 3 ]。 我们所主张的是一种任务分配：凡是产生系统将要据以行动的数字的操作，均由确定性工具执行，而语言模型仅限于执行其优势切实存在、且其失败模式可以承受的操作。

paragraphs.en: The Hypothesizer receives structured residual diagnostics from the Statistician (e.g. “heart-rate residual + 6 +6 bpm on rides with ambient temperature > 27 ∘ >27^{\circ} C, n = 14 n{=}14 ”; “descent times on segment 7 bimodal since week 61”), retrieves candidate mechanisms from the literature, and proposes hypotheses with a formal predicate, a prior log-odds and a test plan. This is mechanism retrieval and analogical reasoning, a genuine language-model capability. The Modeler translates an accepted hypothesis into a model specification drawn from a unit-tested template library (add covariate, add interaction, add changepoint, add random walk, split a parameter by condition); it cannot emit free-form model code, which keeps it from inventing unidentifiable structures. A Critic reviews the specification against identifiability red flags and registry lineage, and the pair iterate at most three times. The Experiment Designer proposes the candidate workout menu 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} (20–40 designs: long aerobic rides, climb repeats on segment s s at heart-rate target h h , descent laps, deloads, a standardized eight-minute test climb; crossed with duration, day and time of day), negotiates calendar and wellness constraints with the athlete in natural language, and explains the final choice. The Scribe writes the weekly report, including counterfactuals such as “had you slept 7 7 h, the twin predicts climb 3 would have been 4 % 4\% faster” (computed by the twin as a posterior predictive under do ⁡ ( sleep = 7 ) \mathrm{do}(\text{sleep}=7) and merely narrated by the model).
paragraphs.zh: 假设者从统计学家那里接收结构化的残差诊断（例如「环境温度 > 27 ∘ >27^{\circ} C 的骑行中心率残差 +6 bpm，n = 14 n{=}14 」；「第 7 段的下坡用时自第 61 周起呈双峰分布」），从文献中检索候选机制，并提出带有形式化谓词、先验对数几率和检验计划的假设。 这是机制检索与类比推理，是语言模型的一项真实能力。 建模者将已被接受的假设转化为从经过单元测试的模板库中提取的模型规范（添加协变量、添加交互项、添加变点、添加随机游走、按条件拆分参数）；它不能输出自由格式的模型代码，这使其无法凭空创造出不可辨识的结构。 评审者依据可辨识性红旗信号和注册表谱系审查该规范，二者最多迭代三次。 实验设计者提出候选训练菜单 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} （20–40 个设计：长距离有氧骑行、在路段 s s 上以目标心率 h h 进行爬坡重复、下坡圈、减量训练、一次标准化的八分钟测试爬坡；并与时长、日期和一天中的时间交叉组合），用自然语言与运动员协商日程和健康约束，并解释最终的选择。 记录员撰写每周报告，包括反事实陈述，例如「如果你睡了 7 7 小时，孪生模型预测爬坡 3 本会快 4 % 4\% 」（由孪生模型作为 do ⁡ ( sleep = 7 ) \mathrm{do}(\text{sleep}=7) 下的后验预测计算得出，模型仅负责叙述）。

paragraphs.en: Scoring the menu against the retrospective posterior ranks an overload week followed by full rest with three repeated test efforts highest ( 0.17 0.17 nats), ahead of a three-week block-and-taper ( 0.16 0.16 ) and all conventional weeks ( ≤ 0.06 \leq 0.06 ): the contrast in which fatigue dissipates while fitness persists is what separates τ 2 \tau_{2} from τ 1 \tau_{1} , as anticipated in Section IV-E . paragraphs.en: The subject is one recreational cross-country mountain biker (an author) whose Garmin record begins with the purchase of a Forerunner 965 on 2 April 2025 and runs to 30 September 2026 (eighteen months). Daily wellness records (556 days) include sleep stages and overnight heart-rate variability ( 77 % 77\% of nights), resting heart rate, stress, body battery and device-computed training metrics (readiness, acute and chronic load, VO 2 max; 98 98 – 99 % 99\% of days). Ambient temperature on rides spans 1 1 – 32 ∘ 32^{\circ} C with 17 17 rides at or above 25 ∘ 25^{\circ} C. Segment discovery yields 24 segments ( 11 11 climbs, 8 8 descents, 5 5 rolling) with 458 traversals; 15 segments have at least ten traversing rides. Three riding areas dominate: a home hill with 153 153 rides, and two mountain networks with 29 29 and 26 26 rides. paragraphs.en: Automatic discovery keys on named OSM trails and therefore fragments long climbs (the home hill’s main gravel ascent is mapped as 22 22 OSM ways and does not survive discovery as a single piece). The instrument climb was instead declared with the athlete as a gate-to-gate route on the home hill (Fig. 2 ; close-ups in Fig. 9 ; GPS traces of every traversal in Fig. 3 ): the Trans Canada Trail from its lower gate to the point where the gravel meets the summit road, 2.06 2.06 km, + 148 +148 m, 7.2 % 7.2\% , a wide, smooth, steady-gradient surface with no technical content, 10 10 minutes from the athlete’s door. Traversals are extracted by gate passage with a corridor check ( ≥ 80 % \geq 80\% of samples within 25 25 m of the trail). Seventy-nine historical traversals (April 2025–September 2026, every month of the record; 90 90 including the prospective phase) take 12 12 – 21 21 min moving (median 17.3 17.3 , robust CV 7.4 % 7.4\% ) at mean heart rates of 130 130 – 176 176 bpm; across those rides each + 1 +1 bpm of mean heart rate buys about 3.6 3.6 s, i.e. the between-ride spread is dominated by effort (Fig. 4 ), which is precisely what the fixed-heart-rate protocol removes. The descent instrument is Nicoles Trail, entered from the summit via Poplar Trail and timed from the Poplar–Nicoles junction to the exit ( 1.16 1.16 km, − 158 -158 m, − 13.6 % -13.6\% , 23 23 traversals, median 5.6 5.6 min, robust CV 9.2 % 9.2\% ). A longer declared climb on a second network ( 5.9 5.9 km, + 425 +425 m, 47 47 min) was considered first and rejected before any prospective ride: it had six traversals against seventy-nine, and an instrument the athlete will ride twice a week has to be near home. The change is logged in the registry (the two ledger predictions registered against the earlier instrument are marked withdrawn, not deleted) and no prospective data is affected.

paragraphs.en: The replay asks a single question: at each point in the past eighteen months, would the system’s beliefs have predicted the following week’s rides better than the alternatives? We step a rolling origin t t weekly after a four-month warm-up. Every method sees data ≤ t \leq t only, including language-model calls (frozen model version, temperature 0 0 , responses cached per origin, three seeds). Each issues predictive distributions for the next seven days of realized rides: (a) traversal time on each matched segment; (b) mean climb heart rate conditional on realized virtual power and temperature; (c) within-ride drift slope; (d) sign of the weekly change in device VO 2 max. Registry hypotheses additionally issue binary ledger predictions.

paragraphs.en: Everything is one long dependent series, so we use forecast-comparison tests built for that case: Diebold–Mariano tests on per-origin score differences with heteroskedasticity- and autocorrelation-consistent variance (lag four weeks) [ 49 ] ; moving-block bootstrap with 14 14 -day blocks for intervals on aggregate differences [ 50 ] ; and Giacomini–White tests of conditional predictive ability to characterize when the agent helps [ 51 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 万事万物构成一条长长的依赖序列，因此我们采用专为该情形设计的预测比较检验：对每个起点的得分差进行 Diebold–Mariano 检验，并采用对异方差和自相关稳健的方差估计（滞后四周）[ 49 ]；对聚合差采用块长为 14 14 天的移动块自助法构建区间 [ 50 ]；以及采用 Giacomini–White 条件预测能力检验来刻画智能体在何时有所帮助 [ 51 ]。

What the agent designs is the training between them: one of fifteen one-, two- or three-week load patterns (conventional, front/back-loaded, deload 50 / 25 / 0 % 50/25/0\% , overload 115 / 130 % 115/130\% and their sequences), chosen by Eq. Before every instrument ride the ledger holds a sealed prediction for it; a ride is scored by the first traversal after sealing, one traversal scores at most one prediction, and a ride through the gates without the lap protocol is training data and never scores. paragraphs.en: With the fixed registry (invariants I7–I8), the hypothesis loop runs causally at every origin: base twin refit, Hypothesizer + Modeler/Critic against a frozen-clock registry, Statistician evaluates open hypotheses (directional claims by Savage–Dickey on the stored fit; structural specs by compiling a linear term and refitting), working model = base + admitted structural specs (belief ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ). Three ablations share the same base fits and differ only in admission: gated (identifiability gate on), no-gate , no-registry (static twin). Across 60 origins the agentic system matches the static twin on HR forecasting (CRPS 7.00 7.00 vs 7.03 7.03 , p = 0.63 p=0.63 ) and segment time ( 0.050 0.050 vs 0.048 0.048 , p = 0.007 p=0.007 , marginally worse). The no-registry ablation is indistinguishable. I7 reduced the hypothesis count from 62 to 40 by blocking duplicate registrations; I8 demoted 5 premature “supported” verdicts when later data disagreed (belief trajectories in Figure 7 ). The honest interpretation: 18 months of observational data, with the current segment network, does not give the hypothesis loop enough contrast to improve forecasts. The designed experiments in the prospective phase (particularly the fresh/loaded pair and the overload–rest contrast) are what the loop needs.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定注册表（不变量 I7–I8）下，假设循环在每个起点都以因果方式运行：基础孪生模型重拟合，Hypothesizer 与 Modeler/Critic 针对冻结时钟的注册表运行，Statistician 评估开放假设（方向性主张通过对已存储拟合的 Savage–Dickey 检验；结构性规格通过编译线性项并重新拟合），工作模型 = 基础模型 + 被采纳的结构性规格（信念 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ）。 三个消融实验共享相同的基础拟合，仅在采纳环节有所不同：gated（开启可识别性门控）、no-gate、no-registry（静态孪生模型）。 在 60 个起点上，智能体系统在 HR 预测上与静态孪生模型相当（CRPS 7.00 7.00 对 7.03 7.03 ，p = 0.63 p=0.63 ），在分段时间上也相当（ 0.050 0.050 对 0.048 0.048 ，p = 0.007 p=0.007 ，略差）。 no-registry 消融实验则无法区分优劣。 I7 通过阻止重复注册将假设数量从 62 个减少到 40 个；I8 在后续数据不一致时降级了 5 个过早的“已支持”判定（信念轨迹见图 7 ）。 诚实的解读是：18 个月的观测数据，加上当前的分段网络，不足以给假设循环提供足够的对比度来改进预测。 前瞻性阶段中设计的实验（尤其是 fresh/loaded 配对和 overload–rest 对比）才是该循环所需要的。

paragraphs.en: No method beats a simple exponentially weighted average of past traversal times (CRPS 0.046 0.046 in log-seconds, i.e. ∼ 4.6 % {\sim}4.6\% ): the fitness–fatigue twin with learned time constants scores 0.048 0.048 , persistence 0.052 0.052 and a Banister model with population constants 0.056 0.056 , none significantly different from one another, while the Gaussian process and ridge baselines are clearly worse ( 0.097 0.097 , 0.109 0.109 ). paragraphs.en: Pre-registered contrasts. Both live cycles sealed a fresh and a loaded climb prediction and stated the falsifier in advance: a loaded test not slower than the fresh one counts against the modelled fatigue penalty. In week 1 the fresh test took 975 975 s and the loaded test 926 926 s; in week 2, 1031 1031 s ( 6.0 6.0 h sleep) and 968 968 s. The falsifier fired twice. The refit that followed moved the fitness–fatigue posterior to τ 1 = 27 \tau_{1}=27 d [ 17 , 59 ] [17,59] , P ⁡ ( τ 1 < 42 ) = 0.80 P(\tau_{1}<42)=0.80 , and τ 2 = 3.7 \tau_{2}=3.7 d [ 0.7 , 15.9 ] [0.7,15.9] ; the identifiability gate still refuses to move H4’s belief from 0.5 0.5 because the prior–posterior overlap is 0.84 0.84 . Two weeks of designed contrast have not resolved what eighteen months of observation could not, and the registry says so.
paragraphs.zh: 预登记的对比检验。 两个实际周期都密封了一个新的和一个负载状态下的爬坡预测，并事先声明了证伪条件：如果负载测试不比新测试慢，则与建模的疲劳惩罚相悖。 第1周，新测试用时 975 975 秒，负载测试用时 926 926 秒；第2周分别为 1031 1031 秒（睡眠 6.0 6.0 小时）和 968 968 秒。 证伪条件触发了两次。 随后的重新拟合将体能–疲劳后验更新为 τ 1 = 27 \tau_{1}=27 天 [ 17 , 59 ] [17,59]，P ⁡ ( τ 1 < 42 ) = 0.80 P(\tau_{1}<42)=0.80，以及 τ 2 = 3.7 \tau_{2}=3.7 天 [ 0.7 , 15.9 ] [0.7,15.9]；可辨识性门控仍然拒绝将 H4 的信念从 0.5 0.5 移动，因为先验–后验重叠度为 0.84 0.84。 两周的设计性对比检验未能解决十八个月的观察所无法解决的问题，注册库也如实说明了这一点。

paragraphs.en: The agent and the safety officer. In both live cycles the design ranked first by expected information gain was an overload week ( 130 % 130\% of the four-week mean); the safety officer vetoed it both times (ACWR 1.35 > 1.3 1.35>1.3 ; weekly load outside ± 15 % \pm 15\% ) and the agent took the second-ranked two-week plan. The ± 15 % \pm 15\% tolerance made the pre-registered overload design logically infeasible. With the athlete’s written consent the cap was raised to ACWR 1.5 1.5 and ± 35 % \pm 35\% and a no-consecutive-overload rule added, effective from the fourth cycle; the change is a protocol_change event in the registry and is not retroactive. The agent also registered six new hypotheses (heat, time of day, wet surface, elapsed time, τ 2 < 7 \tau_{2}<7 d, sleep on climbing heart rate); all remain proposed with | log ⁡ BF | < 0.8 |\log\mathrm{BF}|<0.8 .

paragraphs.en: Audit trail. The registry holds 4 4 score_correction events from this period: three cases in which an ad-hoc scorer matched the wrong ride (date-level instead of timestamp comparison; one traversal claiming two predictions; a training ride claiming a test prediction), each reversed with the wrong value preserved, and the rules that now prevent them (first traversal strictly after sealing; invariant I10, one observation scores one prediction; lap protocol required). We report these because a system whose record is clean on first contact with reality is a system whose record is not being kept. Full registry state, including the six agent-proposed hypotheses, is in Table II .
paragraphs.zh: 审计轨迹。 登记册记录了该期间的 4 条 4 分值修正事件：三例是临时评分器匹配到了错误的骑行记录（用日期级别而非时间戳比较；一次穿越被计入两个预测；将训练骑行当作测试预测来评分），每一例都在保留错误值的情况下被撤销，以及如今防止这些错误的规则（首次穿越严格在封存之后；不变式 I10，一个观测只对应一个预测的评分；要求使用圈数协议）。 我们报告这些，是因为一个在与现实初次接触时记录仍一尘不染的系统，其实是一个根本没有在记录的系统。 完整的登记册状态，包括六条由智能体提出的假设，见表 II。

paragraphs.en: The prospective results are three weeks of one athlete: 14 14 scored predictions and two fresh/loaded contrasts. They are enough to show the ledger working, including against the twin, and not enough to estimate a time constant. The randomized information-directed versus conventional comparison has not yet begun; every live week so far was information-directed. We also changed the instrument (gate position), the descent forecast method and the safety thresholds during the phase. Each change is dated and logged, predictions sealed before a change were scored under the rules in force when sealed, and none was retroactive; but a reader should weigh the first three weeks as a shakedown of the protocol as much as a test of the athlete.

paragraphs.en: Personal-health agents have learned to read wearable data and to speak about it well. We have argued that the next step is not better speech but accountable learning: a system that holds explicit, probabilistic claims about one person, commits to predictions before seeing outcomes, chooses what to observe next, and is judged by whether it was right. EpiCoach realizes this loop for a mountain biker with nothing but a watch, with a protocol that lets language models do what they are good at (propose mechanisms, choose instruments, negotiate with a human, explain) while deterministic tools fit, score, gate and record. Eighteen months of wrist data did not resolve a fitness time constant, and three weeks of designed rides have so far shown the twin to be too slow to follow the athlete it models; a system that writes that down, keeps the wrong scores next to the corrected ones, and can answer “not yet, and here is the week that would help” is, we think, the right kind of coach.
paragraphs.zh: 个人健康智能体已经学会读取可穿戴设备数据，并能就此进行良好的表述。 我们已经论证过，下一步不是更好的表述，而是可问责的学习：一个对某个人持有明确、概率性论断的系统，在看到结果之前先对预测作出承诺，选择接下来要观测什么，并以是否判断正确来接受评判。 EpiCoach 仅凭一块手表，为一名山地自行车骑手实现了这一循环，其协议让语言模型做它们擅长的事（提出机制、选择测量手段、与人协商、解释），同时由确定性工具来进行拟合、评分、把关和记录。 十八个月的手腕数据未能解析出一个健身时间常数，而三周精心设计的骑行到目前为止显示其数字孪生太慢，无法跟上它所建模的运动员；一个能把这一点记录下来、把错误评分保留在修正后的评分旁边、并能回答“还没有，而这周的数据会有所帮助”的系统，我们认为，才是正确类型的教练。

paragraphs.en: For each riding area (a bounding box around a cluster of ride start points) we query OpenStreetMap for ways with a highway tag in {path, track, cycleway, footway, bridleway, service, unclassified, steps} and a name ; responses are cached. Ways sharing a name are greedily joined when endpoints lie within 15 15 m, then densified to 5 5 m. Chains shorter than 100 100 m are dropped. Paved roads ( unclassified ) are retained for segment discovery but excluded from the heart-rate and fitness–fatigue models, where virtual power is unreliable at road speeds.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个骑行区域（围绕一组骑行起点聚类的边界框），我们查询 OpenStreetMap 以获取 highway 标签属于 {path, track, cycleway, footway, bridleway, service, unclassified, steps} 且带有名称的路径；查询结果会被缓存。 名称相同的路径在端点相距 15 15 米以内时会被贪心地拼接起来，然后加密采样至 5 5 米的间隔。 短于 100 100 米的路径链会被舍弃。 铺装道路（unclassified）会被保留用于路段发现，但被排除在心率与体能–疲劳模型之外，因为在公路骑行速度下虚拟功率并不可靠。

sents.en: Accepted if ≥ 85 % \geq 85\% of samples lie within the gates ± 15 \pm 15 m, no inter-sample gap exceeds 90 90 s, progress is monotone for ≥ 90 % \geq 90\% of steps, and duration ≥ 60 \geq 60 s.
sents.zh: 若 ≥ 85% 的样本位于门 ± 15 m 范围内、样本间间隔不超过 90 s、进度在 ≥ 90% 的步骤上单调递增，且持续时间 ≥ 60 s，则判定为接受。

sents.en: Laps yield multiple traversals per run.
sents.zh: 每次跑圈可在一次运行中产生多次穿越。

paragraphs.en: GPS error under canopy of 10 10 – 25 25 m can place a sample on a parallel trail; the 20 20 m snap radius and the monotone-progress test suppress most such errors. Trails absent from OpenStreetMap, or unnamed, produce no segments; in this study 20 % 20\% of ride samples in the main area were unmatched, mostly unsanctioned connectors. Entry/exit jitter of ∼ 1 {\sim}1 s is 2 % 2\% of a 60 60 s descent, so we prefer segments of several minutes for hypothesis testing and report duration alongside every estimate.

paragraphs.en: Weeks are the unit for the information-accrual comparison, randomized in pairs so that each fortnight contains one information-directed and one conventional week. paragraphs.en: Two instrument rides per week on the declared climb, at a fixed heart-rate target of 160 ± 5 160\pm 5 bpm chosen by the athlete as sustainable for the ∼ 17 \sim\!17 min effort (watch alert on the band; lap press where the gravel meets the summit road ends the step), followed by one traversal of the designated descent at self-selected effort. The two rides occupy fixed positions: a fresh test on the first day after the weekly rest day and a loaded test on day 5, after the week’s training. The pair is the within-week fatigue contrast the fitness–fatigue model needs to separate τ 2 \tau_{2} from τ 1 \tau_{1} without special weeks; with one ride a week that contrast is unavailable. Everything between the tests is the athlete’s normal training (rides, football, strength work; all enter the load series, with the caveat that heart-rate-based load under-counts strength sessions). Outcomes: moving time on the climb at the protocol heart rate, descent moving time. Each instrument ride carries ≈ 60 \approx 60 exp-TRIMP, about 12 % 12\% of the athlete’s weekly load, so the plans in the design menu differ only in the remaining training.
paragraphs.zh: 在声明的爬坡路段每周进行两次仪器骑行，固定心率目标为 160 ± 5 160\pm 5 bpm，由运动员选择其可维持约 ∼ 17 \sim\!17 分钟努力的强度（手环上设置心率警报；当碎石路与登顶公路交汇处按下圈数键结束该步骤），随后以自选强度完成一次指定的下坡路段。 这两次骑行占据固定位置：在每周休息日后的第一天进行新鲜状态测试，在第 5 天（即本周训练结束后）进行负荷状态测试。 这一对测试是健身–疲劳模型在无需特殊周的情况下区分 τ 2 \tau_{2} 与 τ 1 \tau_{1} 所需的周内疲劳对比；如果每周只有一次骑行，则无法获得这种对比。 两次测试之间的一切都是运动员的正常训练（骑行、足球、力量训练；全部纳入负荷序列，但需注意基于心率的负荷会低估力量训练的负荷）。 结果指标：协议心率下的爬坡移动时间、下坡移动时间。 每次仪器骑行携带 ≈ 60 \approx 60 exp-TRIMP，约占运动员每周负荷的 12 % 12\%，因此设计菜单中的各方案仅在其余训练上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The pusher serializes d ⋆ d^{\star} as a cycling workout with ordered steps, each with a duration or distance end condition and a heart-rate-zone or custom heart-rate target, creates it through the workout service and schedules it on the target date; the watch receives it after the phone application syncs, which the athlete is prompted to do. Because the endpoint is unofficial, the payload schema is validated against a workout created in the vendor’s own interface and retrieved through the same API, and a file-based fallback (FIT workout copied to the device over USB) is maintained. All requests are paced and retried with exponential backoff; raw responses are archived.
paragraphs.zh: 推送器将 d ⋆ d^{\star} 序列化为一个包含有序步骤的骑行训练，每个步骤带有时长或距离结束条件以及心率区间或自定义心率目标，通过训练服务创建它并安排在目标日期；手机应用同步后手表即可接收，系统会提示运动员进行同步。 由于该端点并非官方，载荷模式会参照在厂商自家界面中创建并通过同一 API 获取的训练进行验证，同时保留基于文件的回退方案（将 FIT 训练文件通过 USB 复制到设备）。 所有请求均以一定节奏发送并采用指数退避进行重试；原始响应会被存档。

sents.en: Because the endpoint is unofficial, the payload schema is validated against a workout created in the vendor’s own interface and retrieved through the same API, and a file-based fallback (FIT workout copied to the device over USB) is maintained.
sents.zh: 由于该端点并非官方，载荷模式会参照在厂商自家界面中创建并通过同一 API 获取的训练进行验证，同时保留基于文件的回退方案（将 FIT 训练文件通过 USB 复制到设备）。

sents.en: All requests are paced and retried with exponential backoff; raw responses are archived.
sents.zh: 所有请求均以一定节奏发送并采用指数退避进行重试；原始响应会被存档。
